summary.en-US: Rule calibration and shadow strategy research answer different questions.
summary.zh-CN: 规则校准与影子策略研究回答不同问题。

question.en-US: Can the available constituent snapshots reproduce daily movements?
question.zh-CN: 现有成分快照能否复现日收益变化？

finding.en-US: Available-snapshot replay correlations are 0.997 for dividends and 0.992 for broad free cash flow.
finding.zh-CN: 现有快照回放相关性为红利 0.997、全市场自由现金流 0.992。

decision.en-US: Use this as local calibration; it does not reconstruct missing constituent history.
decision.zh-CN: 用于局部校准，不代表补齐缺失的历史成分。

title.en-US: Compare portfolio breadth in the shadow history
title.zh-CN: 比较影子历史中的持仓宽度

question.en-US: Does more concentration consistently improve the result?
question.zh-CN: 更集中是否一致改善结果？

finding.en-US: The standard shadow replay varies with breadth and weighting; the return curve is not monotonic.
finding.zh-CN: 标准影子回放随持仓宽度、权重变化，收益曲线并非单调。

decision.en-US: Do not select the best breadth after seeing this table.
decision.zh-CN: 不能看完本表再选择最优持仓宽度。

question.en-US: Can lower turnover be distinguished from alpha?
question.zh-CN: 能否区分降低换手与 Alpha？

finding.en-US: An incumbent buffer reduced turnover; every cost-stress arm lost return as costs increased.
finding.zh-CN: 老持仓缓冲降低了换手；成本阶梯中各臂收益均随成本上升而降低。

decision.en-US: Treat this as construction/cost sensitivity, not an official index replication or capacity claim.
decision.zh-CN: 视为组合构造与成本敏感性，不称官方指数复现或容量结论。

title.en-US: Separate official membership history from weights
title.zh-CN: 区分官方历史成分与权重

question.en-US: Which part of the official index history is now available?
question.zh-CN: 现已取得官方指数历史中的哪部分资料？

finding.en-US: The official 980092 adjustment export covers nine 100-constituent intervals from 2024-09-18 onward. It contains membership changes but no historical weights; the official weight export supplies only a 2026-09-30 snapshot.
finding.zh-CN: 官方 980092 调整导出覆盖自 2024-09-18 起的 9 个区间，每个区间含 100 个成分。文件提供成分变更，但没有历史权重；官方权重导出仅提供 2026-09-30 快照。

decision.en-US: The current methodology took effect on 2024-08-15, but the export does not establish membership through 2024-09-17. Historical weights remain unavailable. This is not a complete ten-year official replication; keep earlier snapshot correlations and shadow portfolio comparisons separate.
decision.zh-CN: 现行方法自 2024-08-15 生效，但导出未覆盖该日至 2024-09-17 的成分。历史权重仍缺失。这不代表完成十年官方指数复现；此前快照相关性和影子组合比较应单独呈现。

title.zh-CN: 影子收益随持仓宽度变化

context.en-US: 980092 standard shadow replay, 80 monthly intervals; mixed historical rules and reconstructed data. Not the official index history.
context.zh-CN: 980092 标准影子回放，80 个月度区间；混合历史规则与重建数据，不是官方指数历史。

interpretation.en-US: Weighting and breadth interact; no monotonic winner or production qualification follows.
interpretation.zh-CN: 权重与持仓宽度相互影响，没有单调赢家或生产资格。

context.en-US: Same equal-weight standard shadow family with incumbent buffering; no unbuffered comparator is plotted here.
context.zh-CN: 同一等权标准影子家族，使用老持仓缓冲；此图没有绘制无缓冲对照。

interpretation.en-US: Larger breadth tends to lower turnover, but this construction diagnostic does not establish alpha.
interpretation.zh-CN: 较大持仓宽度通常降低换手，但这一构造诊断不能确立 Alpha。

next_question.en-US: Can a stable cash-flow rule survive consistent historical rules, PIT and common execution assumptions?
next_question.zh-CN: 稳定现金流规则能否通过一致历史规则、PIT 与共同执行假设检验？

before.en-US: High official-return correlation might be read as complete index replication.
before.zh-CN: 较高官方收益相关性可能被理解为完整指数复现。

trigger.en-US: Available snapshots leave missing historical constituents and rule changes.
trigger.zh-CN: 可用快照仍缺历史成分，并存在规则变化。

after.en-US: Treat calibration and current-rule shadows as separate, bounded evidence.
after.zh-CN: 将校准与现行规则影子视为独立且有边界的证据。
